entries.topic: Second chance downstairs for a Kara who hid
originals: Whether a Kara who hid really gets a second chance in the fight?
entries.answer: Yes; a Kara who already stunned Todd upstairs does not
entries.source: wiki Stormy Night Notes: 'If Kara hides from Todd and fails to fight him downstairs, Kara will be presented with the same chance to charge and stun Todd downstairs. Otherwise, if Kara already stunned Todd upstairs, Kara will shut down.'

entries.topic: Gun taken but Todd not shot
originals: Gun taken but Todd not shot?
entries.answer: With the gun every room-fight outcome is a shooting (Kara or Alice); there is no stun. Hanging back instead is the after-Todd timeout, the same outcome as not deviating (TODD KILLS ALICE)
entries.source: template 'IF Took the gun' (three variants, all 'Kara kills Todd' or 'Alice kills Todd'); 'IF Going upstairs after Todd: [TIME: Take too much time] Leads to the same outcome as "Don't go / Don't become a deviant"'; wiki Notes 'Kara will have to do nothing which will result in Alice and then Kara too'

entries.topic: Where KARA IS TOO SLOW comes from
originals: KARA IS TOO SLOW incoming edge?
Whether KARA IS TOO SLOW can also follow GO UPSTAIRS if Kara dawdles?
entries.answer: From doing nothing downstairs, and from dawdling once Todd is in Alice's room. Dawdling in the corridor before Todd arrives is not it: that is 'Stay in the hallway' → shove → after Todd
entries.source: template 'Going upstairs before Todd: [TIME: Stay in the hallway] … Leads to the same outcome as "Going upstairs after Todd"' and 'Going upstairs after Todd: [TIME: Take too much time] … same outcome as "Don't go / Don't become a deviant"'; en.json 02K.TIME = 'KARA IS TOO SLOW'; PowerPyx 'Walk to the kitchen instead'
